title: Personality Latents: Conditioning Frozen Language Models on Individuals from Their Own Writing
abstract: arXiv:2610.36805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Controlling the personality of a language model usually relies on written profiles or named trait categories, so it can only express what an author writes down or what a taxonomy names. We instead propose Personality Latents (PL), which learn a latent for each person from their own writing, with no personality labels and no authored profile, and inject it into a frozen language model as a soft prefix. Following generative latent optimization, each training person receives a free latent that is optimized through the frozen model itself, while an encoder learns to predict these latents so that a new person needs only one forward pass, with optional refinement at test time. We evaluate on held-out people by having the conditioned model answer neutral and interview questions and reading personality from its answers with scorers trained on real human writing. On the MBTI axes PL reaches an AUC of , ahead of persona embedding and prompt-based

translated_title: 人格潜变量：基于个人自身写作对冻结语言模型进行个体化条件控制
translated_abstract: 控制语言模型的人格通常依赖于书面的人物简介或命名的特质类别，因此模型只能表达作者所写下的内容或分类体系所定义的内容。我们转而提出人格潜变量，它从每个人自己的写作中为其学习一个潜变量，无需任何人格标签，也无需撰写的人物简介，并将该潜变量作为软前缀注入冻结的语言模型。该方法遵循生成式潜变量优化的思路：每位训练个体获得一个自由潜变量，并通过冻结模型本身进行优化；同时，一个编码器学习预测这些潜变量，使得新个体只需一次前向传播即可获得其潜变量，并可在测试时进行可选的细化。我们在留出个体上进行评估：让经条件化的模型回答中性问题和访谈式问题，然后使用在真实人类写作上训练的评分器从其回答中读取人格特质。在 MBTI 各维度上，PL 取得了领先的 AUC 表现，优于人格嵌入和基于提示的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出“人格潜变量”（PL）方法，无需人格标签或自撰简介，直接从个人写作中为其学习潜变量并作为软前缀注入冻结语言模型，使模型能够精确表达该个体的独特人格。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Personality Latents (PL), which learns a latent for each individual directly from their own writing—without personality labels or authored profiles—and injects it as a soft prefix into a frozen language model to condition it on that person's unique personality.
